title: huddle.json
description: Configuration of Huddle for one repository. No secrets ever go in it.

project.description: owner/repo on GitHub, or the project path (groups allowed) on GitLab.

ai_manager.description: Login of the AI Manager: the only person whose comments count as requests.

assignees.description: Logins of the team that get ready Issues.

max_open_per_person.description: Nobody gets more open Issues than this.

progress_issue.description: false turns off the «Huddle progress» Issue that `huddle labels` keeps up to date. Default: true.

clean_worktrees.description: false stops the session start from removing finished worktrees (clean, merged into the default branch, untouched for 24 hours). `huddle clean` still works by hand. Default: true.

labels.description: Optional renames of the seven status labels.
